# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B06

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

According to the deposit README, the power signal adopts a charge-positive polarity convention for power flow.
The deposit records interval times for current but does not declare the sample point inside the interval.
According to the data dictionary the voltage interval is closed-closed.
No discrete sampling events are defined for the power; fixed-interval and event-driven policies therefore do not apply.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

The accompanying description confirms that power is a measured channel.
The data dictionary lists the index recovery method for step index as time_segmentation_rule.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Completeness of the voltage records is verified using: gap_flag_column.
The protocol sheet mentions a unit attribute for the current channel but leaves the concrete unit (A or mA) unspecified.
According to the README, energy values are stored without multiplicative or affine scaling.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B06 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B06.
